300/500 Assisted Promotional Housing
RESIDENTIAL AND COMMERCIAL PROGRAMME

The completed 300-home phase of a 500-home Assisted Promotional Housing (LPA) programme in Douaouda, comprising ground floor plus 8 upper floors (R+8) residential blocks, integrated commercial premises, and comprehensive roads and utility networks (VRD).

Douaouda brings the completed 300-home phase of a 500-home assisted promotional housing programme into a coastal setting, pairing family housing with professional premises and organised exterior works.
The project was executed under a complete all-trades package (TCE), encompassing reinforced concrete structural works, secondary trades, building services coordination, and exterior finishing.

The R+8 blocks are configured with F3 and F4 apartment layouts. The ground-level commercial spaces establish active street-level frontage, integrating local retail and services directly into the residential fabric.
A multi-storey residential development delivered through unified structural engineering, building services integration, and site circulation works.

What is the scope of the 300/500 Assisted Promotional Housing project?
It represents the completed 300-home phase of a larger 500-home Assisted Promotional Housing (LPA) development in Douaouda, featuring R+8 residential blocks and integrated commercial premises.
What construction services were provided for this development?
The project was executed under an all-trades delivery (TCE) contract, covering reinforced concrete structures, secondary trades, building services, and roads and utility networks (VRD).
Who is the client for this housing programme?
The development was delivered for the National Housing Improvement and Development Agency (AADL) under the state-assisted promotional housing framework.
